name: confirmChoice
meaning: s8: Prompt_Update reads it with movsx at 0x53ebd9 (not a scroll row). Written by Ui_DrawTextBox only when fits is set, as 2 - g_confirmPage.cursor (0x6de168) after it runs the confirm menu (Menu_SetCurrent(&g_confirmPage); Menu_Update(2,2)). It is the Yes/No answer: 1 = first row, 0 = second

name: fits
meaning: 1 when lineCount+3 fits in the font's row count; the paging UI is only run when set

name: rect
meaning: {x, y, w, h} in virtual HUD space; the frame is drawn inflated by 4 on every side

name: bgColor
meaning: panel fill colour, forced to 0x080808 by Ui_DrawTextBox
